user.title: Spraying Control
user.description: Pick the phone or tracker you carry while spraying, then describe your knapsack sprayer. Walking back to the refill point is counted as a tank refill.

data.base_min_stop_s: Minimum stop to count as a refill

data_description.swath_width_m: How wide a band you treat on one pass. A single wide-angle nozzle covers roughly a metre.
data_description.base: Drag the marker to where you refill the backpack, and size the circle to cover that spot.
data_description.max_speed_kmh: Anything faster is treated as just walking, not spraying.
data_description.max_gap_s: No band is drawn across a longer silence, because the route is unknown.
data_description.daily_time: Leave empty to only analyse on demand via the spraying_control.analyze action.

error.speed_window: The slowest spraying speed must be below the fastest.

abort.already_configured: That device tracker is already set up.

analyze.name: Analyse a run
analyze.description: Reads the tracker's recorded positions for a day and works out coverage, misses, overlap and product used.

date.name: Date
date.description: Local day to analyse. Defaults to today.

config_entry_id.name: Sprayer
config_entry_id.description: Which configured sprayer to analyse. Defaults to all of them.
